citations.title: SpaceX Acquires AI Coding Tool Cursor, Musk Unveils Grok Bot as It Takes Your Job
excerpts:
Grok Bot is a 24/7 AI agent launched by xAI. Like a real person, it has its own persistent cloud computer that keeps working even after you close your laptop.
It is the first product born from SpaceX's $60 billion acquisition of Cursor. Just days after the deal closed, Grok Bot went live alongside xAI.
It logs into tools and websites you already use, continuously executing multi-step tasks around the clock, whether you are at your desk or not.
Image: Source: x.ai/bot
Essentially, Grok Bot is the closed-source version of OpenClaw and Hermes, two frameworks I have previously covered on this blog.
SpaceX went public on June 12 this year. At today's share price, it ranks as the ninth most valuable asset globally, with a market capitalization nearing $2 trillion.
Image: Source: 8marketcap.com
Prior to the IPO, owner Elon Musk had already merged his AI company xAI into the entity, forming a subsidiary called SpaceXAI.
